description: Run a read-only SQL SELECT against a DataCanvas table staged by fema_search_nfip. Enables aggregation, GROUP BY, SUM/COUNT, time-series, and filtered analysis over the full NFIP claims result without re-fetching from the API. Call fema_dataframe_describe first to get the exact table name and column names needed for valid SQL. Only SELECT statements are allowed — DDL, DML, COPY, and file-reading functions are blocked.

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID from the fema_search_nfip response (the canvas_id field).

query.description: SQL SELECT statement to run against the staged table. Use the table name from fema_dataframe_describe. Results are capped at the canvas row limit; append LIMIT/OFFSET to page through additional rows, or aggregate (GROUP BY, COUNT, SUM) to summarize the full set in one query. Example: "SELECT year_of_loss, COUNT(*) AS claims, SUM(amount_paid_building) AS total_building_paid FROM df_nfip_abc123 GROUP BY year_of_loss ORDER BY year_of_loss"

name: fema_dataframe_query

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID that was queried — reuse for follow-up queries.

cap.description: The canvas row limit that was applied when the result was capped.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `sql_execution_error`: A SELECT fails while converting or calculating values in the staged data. `canvas_not_found`: The canvas_id does not correspond to an active canvas session. `canvas_unavailable`: DataCanvas is disabled on this deployment (CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE is not set to duckdb). `invalid_query`: The SQL statement is not a valid SELECT, references a non-existent table or column, or uses blocked operations. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Continuation guidance when capped — how to page the remainder with LIMIT/OFFSET.

row_count.description: Number of rows in this response (may be capped at the canvas row limit).

rows.description: Result rows from the query. May be capped at the canvas row limit — when the truncated enrichment field is set, page the remainder with LIMIT/OFFSET (see the notice guidance).

items.description: A single result row — keys are column names from the SELECT, values are the computed data.

shown.description: Number of rows returned in this (capped) response.

truncated.description: True when the result was capped at the canvas row limit — more rows match than were returned.

title: Query FEMA DataCanvas Table
